tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background of the Landing 01 frame, behind the header and cards.

tokens.name: main-header
tokens.usage: Header band fill. Figma style main/header. Wordmark `main-logo` and icons `icon-ink` read on it.

tokens.name: main-logo
tokens.usage: Wordmark and all text on `main-header` (4.53:1), `card-surface` (4.5:1) and `surface-page` (5.1:1). Figma style main/logo. Also the focus ring color; every surface gives it more than the 3:1 a focus indicator needs. Never fade text with opacity.

tokens.name: card-surface
tokens.usage: Card fill. `main-logo` text reads on it at 4.5:1.

tokens.name: card-border
tokens.usage: 3px card outline. Decoration only, 1.19:1 on `surface-page`; never use it to carry meaning.

tokens.name: icon-ink
tokens.usage: Nav icon strokes on `main-header` (18.6:1), as drawn in the frame.

tokens.name: ui-border
tokens.usage: Outline of inputs, search fields and unfilled buttons, 3px. Same ink as the text, so it clears the 3:1 that a control edge needs (5.1:1 on `surface-page`, 4.5:1 on `card-surface`). Use this, not `card-border`, wherever the edge carries meaning.

tokens.name: state-error
tokens.usage: Proposed. Error text and outlines: 6.65:1 on `surface-page`, 5.87:1 on `card-surface`, 5.9:1 on `main-header`. Always pair with an icon or words, never color alone.

tokens.name: state-success
tokens.usage: Proposed. Success text and outlines: 6.45:1 on `surface-page`, 5.69:1 on `card-surface`, 5.73:1 on `main-header`. Always pair with an icon or words, never color alone.

styles.name: logo-text
styles.usage: Wordmark in the header. Mona12 Bold; the font file is not part of this system yet.

styles.name: logo-text-compact
styles.usage: Wordmark in the thin header used by the wireframes and the Header component. Mona12 Bold (`fonts/Mona12-Bold.woff2`).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Document title on the wiki page. Taken from the wireframes.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Page and panel headings (h1, h2). Taken from the wireframes.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text, search fields, dates. Taken from the wireframes.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, chips and badges. Taken from the wireframes.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Footer note and other small print. Taken from the wireframes.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Label to field gap in forms.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between nav items and between chips.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Header padding and gap, logo vertical padding, navbar padding, user icon vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Logo horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: User icon horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-96
tokens.usage: Gap between nav icons in the Figma header. The thin header uses `space-12` between nav items instead.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of the thin header and footer; gap between page columns.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: All four corners of cards; the bottom corners of the header band and the top corners of the footer band.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Nav items, buttons, chips, inputs and search fields. Taller than 80px would no longer be a full pill.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Multi-line text areas and image frames, where a full pill would crush the corners.

tokens.name: main-shadow
tokens.usage: Header band shadow. Figma style main/shadow.

tokens.name: card-shadow
tokens.usage: Card shadow.

tokens.name: footer-shadow
tokens.usage: Footer band shadow: `main-shadow` mirrored upward.

tokens.name: icon-size
tokens.usage: Width and height of each nav icon button in the Figma header. The thin header uses `nav-item-height` and `pixel-icon-size`.

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: Card outline width.

tokens.name: card-width
tokens.usage: Card width in Landing 01.

tokens.name: card-height
tokens.usage: Card height in Landing 01.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Thin header band.

tokens.name: footer-height
tokens.usage: Footer band.

tokens.name: nav-item-height
tokens.usage: Height of a nav pill.

tokens.name: pixel-icon-size
tokens.usage: Pixel icon beside a nav label (16 by 16 grid, drawn at 2x).

tokens.name: field-height
